what: A horizontally overflowing photo strip is pushed left by the page’s overall scroll ratio — on each scroll it follows the new position (overwrite) with .5s power2.out, gliding slightly late. Can be grabbed and dragged by hand (horizontal only, blocked at strip ends) and after release follows the scroll again from where it was left

options.dur: Duration (s) of following the scroll, default .5 — 0 attaches immediately
options.rate: Ratio the band is pushed when scrolled to the end of the page (based on overflow width), default 1
options.clamp: If 1, the band is kept from passing its end even after it is turned off — by default, as in the original, it is not limited
options.inertia: If 1 and InertiaPlugin is loaded, it glides with inertia on release — the original does not load the plugin, so no inertia
options.[data-fx-part=track]: Strip holding the cells lined up side by side (required)

note: The original uses lastX as-is as the reference after a drag, so the strip jumped once on the next scroll — fixed to follow on from where it was dragged. Following also stopped when the strip was only pressed and released, which is now cleared on release

from.where: index.html .hero-strip (square Work strip below the Hero — Draggable type x + scroll ratio)
